Wood.description: Requires proof-of-work to produce, as well as a pocketknife or an axe. The cheapest resource--fast to produce, and used as a basic building block to craft various tools and upgrades. Can be converted directly to bits at a rate of 1 bit per wood.

Stone.description: Requires proof-of-work to produce, as well as a pocketknife or a quarry. An easy-to-produce resource used as a building block for crafting various tools and upgrades. Can be converted directly to bits at a rate of 2 bits per stone.

Iron.description: Requires proof-of-work to produce, as well as a pocketknife or a mining drill. Slightly more expensive to produce than wood or stone, and used as an ingredient into higher-level tools and upgrades. Can be converted directly to bits at a rate of 5 bits per iron.

Stick.description: Produced from wood. Used for crafting axes.

BucketOfWood.description: Holds any amount of wood. You can add 1, 5, 10, or 50 wood at a time to the bucket. You can remove wood from the bucket so long as the bucket is not empty.

BucketOfStone.description: Holds any amount of stone. You can add 1, 5, 10, or 50 stone at a time to the bucket. You can remove stone from the bucket so long as the bucket is not empty.

BucketOfIron.description: Holds any amount of iron. You can add 1, 5, 10, or 50 iron at a time to the bucket. You can remove iron from the bucket so long as the bucket is not empty.

Pocketknife.summary: A basic tool for gathering wood, stone, and iron.
Pocketknife.description: A basic tool that allows you to gather wood, stone, and iron. Gathers resources very slowly. Infinite durability.

WoodAxe.summary: A basic axe for chopping wood.
WoodAxe.description: Chops 2 wood per use, and breaks after 100 uses. Can be upgraded to a stone axe.

StoneAxe.summary: A solid axe for chopping wood.
StoneAxe.description: Chops 3 wood per use, and breaks after 100 uses. Made by upgrading a wood axe with 1 stone. Can be upgraded to an iron axe.

IronAxe.summary: A powerful axe for chopping wood.
IronAxe.description: Chops 4 wood per use, and breaks after 100 uses. Made by upgrading a stone axe with 1 iron.

Quarry.description: Requires wood and stone to build or upgrade: 20 wood and 10 stone for a level 1 quarry, with upgrade costs doubling at every level. Mines 2 stone per action at level 1, 3 stone per action at level 2, etc.

MiningDrill.description: Requires wood, stone, and iron to build or upgrade: 10 wood, 50 stone, and 5 iron for a level 1 mining drill, with upgrade costs doubling at every level. Mines 2 iron per action at level 1, 3 iron per action at level 2, etc. Consumes 5 wood per mining action.

Bit.description: Can be produced from wood, stone, or iron at a rate of 1 bit per wood, 2 bits per stone, or 5 bits per iron.

CraftPocketknife.summary: Create a pocketknife. Requires no inputs.
CraftPocketknife.description: Create a pocketknife, an infinite-durability tool used for gathering wood, stone, and iron.

GatherWood.summary: Use a pocketknife to produce 1 wood. (~15 seconds)
GatherWood.description: Produce 1 wood using a pocketknife. Requires performing a small amount of proof-of-work hash mining, approximately ~15 seconds on a modern CPU.

GatherStone.summary: Use a pocketknife to produce 1 stone. (~30 seconds)
GatherStone.description: Produce 1 stone using a pocketknife. Requires performing a small amount of proof-of-work hash mining, approximately ~30 seconds on a modern CPU.

GatherIron.summary: Use a pocketknife to produce 1 iron. (~60 seconds)
GatherIron.description: Produce 1 iron using a pocketknife. Requires performing a small amount of proof-of-work hash mining, approximately ~60 seconds on a modern CPU.

CraftWoodAxe.summary: Make a wooden axe from 2 sticks and 1 wood.
CraftWoodAxe.description: Consumes 2 sticks and 1 wood to create a wooden axe, which chops wood twice as fast as a pocketknife. Axes start with 100 durability, meaning that they are unusable after 100 uses.

CraftStoneAxe.summary: Upgrade a wooden axe to a stone axe using 1 stone.
CraftStoneAxe.description: Consumes a wooden axe and 1 stone to create a stone axe, which chops wood three times as fast as a pocketknife. Axes start with 100 durability, meaning that they are unusable after 100 uses.

CraftIronAxe.summary: Upgrade a stone axe to an iron axe using 1 iron.
CraftIronAxe.description: Consumes a stone axe and 1 iron to create an iron axe, which chops wood four times as fast as a pocketknife. Axes start with 100 durability, meaning that they are unusable after 100 uses.

BuildQuarry.description: A level 1 quarry mines stone twice as fast as a pocketknife. Quarries have infinite durability, and can be upgraded to produce stone even faster.

BuildMiningDrill.summary: Make a level 1 mining drill using 10 wood, 50 stone, and 5 iron.
BuildMiningDrill.description: A level 1 mining drill mines iron twice as fast as a pocketknife. Mining drills have infinite durability, and can be upgraded to produce iron even faster.

LevelUpQuarry1.summary: Upgrades a level 1 quarry to level 2.
LevelUpQuarry1.description: Only works on a quarry at exactly level 1. Spends a bucket holding exactly 40 wood and a bucket holding exactly 20 stone. A level 2 quarry mines stone 3 times as fast as a pocketknife.

LevelUpMiningDrill1.summary: Upgrades a level 1 mining drill to level 2.
